task.description:
Validate test design for EXP-301, EXP-302, EXP-303 — HARD GATE (Step 3b).

Verify:
1. Test case coverage: every MUST requirement acceptance criterion has at least one integration test
2. No test.skip on MUST tests
3. Fixture isolation: tests use per-test UUIDs; TestHarness wraps in rolled-back transactions or per-test cleanup
4. Test self-sufficiency: generate required data, verify DB availability with clear failure messages
5. No mocks/stubs except explicit StubEffectsExecutor for EXP-303
6. Test files are ready for TEST-RUNNER execution

If any check fails: return FAIL with detailed issues and route back to TEST-DESIGNER for rework.
If all checks pass: return PASS and route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 4).
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has at least one test case
No test.skip on MUST requirement tests
All fixtures use per-test UUIDs and cleanup
Tests self-sufficient and clear on failure

result.summary: Test design is incomplete for EXP-301/302/303. EXP-302 has no runnable coverage, and several EXP-301/303 cases are placeholders or assertion-only checks.

issues.description: EXP-302 has no runnable integration tests. The spec defines TC-EXP-302-01 through TC-EXP-302-08, but the integration file contains no matching test blocks.

EXP-301 is only partially exercised. TC-EXP-301-05 verifies only literal constants, TC-EXP-301-07 checks a local struct field instead of HTTP header injection, TC-EXP-301-08 compares identical string literals, and TC-EXP-301-09 does not call the email adapter.
EXP-303 is missing most of its required cases. Only TC-EXP-303-01, 02, 06, and 08 are present; the remaining cases required by the spec are absent.
Fixture isolation is weak on the stub-executor surface because several tests use hardcoded instance or effect IDs instead of fresh per-test UUIDs and do not establish explicit cleanup state.
